integrated_answer.claim: GET/POST /api/v1/accounts/:account_id/conversations/:conversation_id/labels select index/create. Parameters permit conversation_id and labels:[], an array; no controller title catalogue whitelist is shown.

Before actions select Current.account, conditionally check access-token API/MFA, find the account's conversation by display_id, then authorize show?. Detailed helper/policy rules remain outside scope.
GET reads label_list; POST calls update_labels and reads label_list. update_labels assigns update!(label_list: labels), unlike separate add_labels. Both templates contain json.payload @labels.
Successful rendering therefore yields {"payload":[...]} and assignment/replacement semantics. Normalization, validation and catalogue enforcement require uninspected persistence/tagging internals.

Distinct account label CRUD uses policy-scoped records, account-scoped id lookup, create/update, destroy and queued association removal. It requires the :label container, permitting title/description/color/show_on_sidebar; these fields are not each required by strong params.

Request spec has four examples: unauthenticated GET/POST expect unauthorized; same-account inbox-member agent GET/POST expect success and label substrings. One selected gap: POST never asserts old labels absent or exact payload, so assignment/response contract remains unverified by these assertions.
